Description
This newly designed 1 OZ
PAMP Suisse
Gold Bar is manufactured in Switzerland, and is composed of 1 oz 999.9% fine gold. The Buddha Bar is one of five bars to be released as part of the PAMP Gold Series, with each uniquely designed in celebration of different religious figures, monuments and icons. The word Buddha means “awakened one” or “enlightened one”, born in Nepal in the 6th century B.C., Buddha was a spiritual leader and teacher whose life serves as the foundation of the Buddhist Religion. The reverse side of this bar captures the image of Buddha surrounded by diagonal lines. The obverse side features a circular PAMP logo, along with the words “SUISSE” “5g” “FINE GOLD” “999.9” and an individualized serial number. This bar is packaged in its original assay card which guarantees the Gold metal weight and purity.
